role: independent semantic reviewer; first pass of unadjudicated diagrams
method: Read all 46 actual Mermaid bodies and the whole surrounding pages; inspect all 46 rendered PNGs through contact sheets and the ambiguous originals; compare code paths and finite lab models to selected primary source spans. Integrity checks bind bytes but did not produce semantic judgments. No exercise/test reruns, source edits, deploys or production mutations.
source_limit: Etcd/CNPG judgments use the dated literal command/result records in s6-platform.md, not a new runtime measurement or an independent raw command transcript. They validate that the diagram faithfully renders the documentary capture. Graph was queried afresh against the unchanged 13/10 snapshot before a read-only PostgreSQL identity/catalog confirmation.
round_budget: One first pass; only HIGH may return once to same reviewer. Mediums are backlog under root round gate.
